name: Open-Bay Four-Bar Pin Cradle
mechanism_family: Roller intake feeding a four-bar lifting cradle
scoring_sequence: Capture a lying or upright Pin between compliant rollers, settle it into the curved cradle, then raise and tip the four-bar to place it onto a Goal.
distinguishing_idea: The open-front chassis surrounds the object while paired four-bar links keep a deep cradle approximately level through most of the lift.
main_uncertainty: Approximate cradle clearances and passive orientation behavior require development; joints and controllers are not implemented in this preview.

name: Belt-Mast Cup Fork
mechanism_family: Two-stage belt elevator with centering funnel and fork carriage
scoring_sequence: Draw a Cup through the low funnel, center it against the carriage, elevate it vertically, and extend the fork slightly forward for controlled placement.
distinguishing_idea: A compact nested mast separates vertical lift from the short placement stroke, avoiding a long swinging arm.
main_uncertainty: Cup retention during carriage acceleration and belt routing are unresolved; joints and controllers are not implemented in this preview.

name: Rotary Pin Indexing Drum
mechanism_family: Horizontal-axis indexing drum with intake throat and discharge p‑
scoring_sequence: Feed a Pin into one drum pocket, rotate the drum to orient and elevate it, then open the upper guide gate so the pocket rolls it onto the Goal.
distinguishing_idea: Acquisition, reorientation, and lift are combined in a quarter-turn pocketed drum rather than a separate arm and gripper.
main_uncertainty: Pocket geometry for both upright and lying Pins is approximate; joints and controllers are not implemented in this preview.

name: Scissor Basket Goal Loader
mechanism_family: Scissor lift carrying a split-entry retention basket
scoring_sequence: Sweep a Pin or Cup into the low basket, close the flexible entry rollers, raise the basket vertically with the scissor, and tilt its floor to release onto a Goal.
distinguishing_idea: The game object remains in one guarded basket from floor pickup through scoring while the symmetric scissor supplies elevation.
main_uncertainty: Scissor stiffness, basket tipping clearance, and track packaging are conceptual; joints and controllers are not implemented in this preview.

name: Articulated Conveyor Bridge
mechanism_family: Segmented belt conveyor with an over-center scoring bridge
scoring_sequence: Collect a lying Pin or Cup onto the lower conveyor, carry it up between side guides, then rotate the upper conveyor segment over the Goal for a gentle powered discharge.
distinguishing_idea: A continuous transfer path uses a fixed lower incline and independently pivoting upper bridge instead of lifting the object in a carriage.
main_uncertainty: Transition behavior between conveyor segments and object stability near the hinge remain unresolved; joints and controllers are not implemented in this preview.

name: Turntable Crane Collar
mechanism_family: Slewing crane with cable-suspended capture collar
scoring_sequence: Side rollers center an upright Cup or Pin beneath the collar; the collar closes, the winch raises it, and the turret slews the boom over the selected Goal for lowering.
distinguishing_idea: A rotating crane separates vertical cable lift from horizontal placement and can approach Goals from several headings.
main_uncertainty: Controlling swing and preventing the suspended object from twisting during travel.

name: Pocket Chain High-Side Loader
mechanism_family: Continuous bucket-chain elevator with tipping head chute
scoring_sequence: A low roller throat pushes lying or upright objects into a flexible pocket; paired chains carry successive pockets upward and invert them over a short top chute.
distinguishing_idea: The object rides in circulating pockets rather than on a lifting carriage, allowing acquisition to continue while another pocket approaches scoring height.
main_uncertainty: Pocket shape must retain both orientations without jamming as it rounds the upper sprockets.

name: Lead-Screw Tilting Table
mechanism_family: Differential lead-screw lift table with powered orientation nest
scoring_sequence: Counter-rotating floor rollers draw an object onto a V-shaped table; two independently driven screw struts raise and tilt the table until its front gate opens over a Goal.
distinguishing_idea: Elevation and controlled discharge come from differential screw extension, without a mast, swinging boom, or scissor stack.
main_uncertainty: The screws and table guides may experience high side loading when the object sits near the front edge.

name: Arc-Rail Placement Trolley
mechanism_family: Curved-rail trolley with roller cradle
scoring_sequence: The open bay admits a Pin or Cup into the roller cradle; a chain-driven trolley follows paired quarter-arc rails, carrying the cradle upward and forward before a wrist roller meters the object onto the Goal.
distinguishing_idea: A constrained trolley follows a curved placement path instead of translating on a straight elevator or rotating about one arm pivot.
main_uncertainty: Low-friction guidance through the segmented arc and chain tension around the curve require development.

name: Twin-Rocker Hand-Off Loader
mechanism_family: Sequential rocking saddles with controlled hand-off
scoring_sequence: A front saddle captures a lying or upright object, rocks rearward to stand and elevate it, then transfers it into a second saddle that rocks forward to the chosen Goal height.
distinguishing_idea: Two short rotary stages pass the object between guarded nests, avoiding one large lift arm and keeping each stage within the chassis envelope.
main_uncertainty: Reliable hand-off timing across varying Pin and Cup orientations is the principal geometric risk.

name: Walking-Beam Pin Stepper
mechanism_family: Alternating walking-beam lift with roller entry and top pusher
scoring_sequence: Floor rollers draw in a lying Pin; alternating toothed beams support and step it upward, while a top cross-roller turns it upright and a short pusher slides it onto the Goal.
distinguishing_idea: Two oscillating ladder beams alternately capture and raise the object through discrete guarded stages rather than carrying it in one carriage.
main_uncertainty: Approximate tooth spacing and beam phasing needed to retain both Pins and Cups during each hand-off.

name: Shoulder-Slide Cup Tongs
mechanism_family: Luffing shoulder with telescoping rack boom and opposed cup tongs
scoring_sequence: A low compliant mouth centers an upright or tilted Cup, the opposed tongs close below its rim, the shoulder raises it, and the nested boom extends for controlled release above a Goal.
distinguishing_idea: A powered shoulder supplies height while a rack-driven telescoping boom independently supplies reach; the object is retained by rim tongs rather than a tray.
main_uncertainty: Tong geometry and compliance required to accommodate approximate Cup and Pin flange profiles without binding.

name: Skew-Roller Spiral Tower
mechanism_family: Counter-rotating skew-roller chimney with top placement gate
scoring_sequence: A wide floor throat captures a lying Pin or Cup; lower rollers center it, successive opposing skew rollers rotate and advance it upward, and a hinged top gate guides the emerging object onto the selected Goal.
distinguishing_idea: Helical surface motion from angled rollers both orients and elevates the object continuously, without a lift carriage, bucket chain, or conveyor belt.
main_uncertainty: Roller skew angle and surface compliance needed to generate upward travel without ejecting irregularly oriented objects.

name: Inverting Yoke Goal Capper
mechanism_family: Large-radius rotary yoke with split scoop and retention hoop
scoring_sequence: The open front surrounds a lying Cup or Pin, split rollers pull it into the scoop, and the side-driven yoke rotates the retained object over the robot into an upright, downward placement pose above a Goal.
distinguishing_idea: One open yoke deliberately inverts the captured object through a broad arc, using gravity against a retention hoop to convert floor orientation into top-down placement.
main_uncertainty: Clearance between the rotating object, chassis opening, and Goal across the approximate object dimensions.

name: Cartesian Goal-Side Gantry
mechanism_family: Overhead longitudinal gantry with rack-lowered expanding gripper
scoring_sequence: A front funnel and centering rollers stage an upright object between the pods; the overhead carriage travels forward, lowers an internal expanding gripper, lifts the object vertically, traverses beyond the bumper, and lowers it onto a Goal.
distinguishing_idea: Independent horizontal and vertical Cartesian axes approach the object and Goal from above while the chassis remains clear around the staging bay.
main_uncertainty: Required mast stiffness and gripper expansion range for stable top-down handling at the highest approximate Goal.

name: Helical Paddle Pin Riser
mechanism_family: Vertical auger elevator with compliant paddle flights and a top e
scoring_sequence: Front rollers draw a lying or upright object into the guarded well; rotating helical paddles raise and turn it, then a short top gate directs it onto the Goal.
distinguishing_idea: A central auger-like paddle stack continuously elevates and reorients the object without a carriage, circulating bucket, or belt conveyor.
main_uncertainty: Approximate paddle pitch, guide clearance, and flange interaction require development; joints and controls are not implemented in this preview.

name: Inclined Winch Cradle
mechanism_family: Cable-winch funicular cradle on paired inclined rails
scoring_sequence: A split front scoop captures the object, the winch pulls its wheeled cradle up straight inclined rails, and a hinged nose plate rolls the object gently onto the selected Goal.
distinguishing_idea: The loaded cradle climbs a fixed diagonal railway under cable tension, combining lift and forward reach without a vertical mast or curved trolley path.
main_uncertainty: Cable routing, cradle retention on abrupt motion, and useful rail angle remain unresolved; joints and controls are not implemented in this preview.

name: Barrel-Cam Carousel Setter
mechanism_family: Vertical-axis staging carousel with barrel-cam follower saddles
scoring_sequence: Side rollers feed an object into a radial saddle; carousel rotation indexes it around the column while a cam follower raises that saddle, and a radial pusher completes placement.
distinguishing_idea: Rotation around a shaped central cam simultaneously indexes and elevates individual saddles, providing staged storage and lift without a conventional linear elevator.
main_uncertainty: The cam profile, follower loading, and reliable retention of both Cup and Pin orientations are only conceptual; joints and controls are not implemented.

name: Sector-Arm Rim Nest
mechanism_family: Geared sector shoulder with independently rotating rim nest
scoring_sequence: A floor-level roller nest centers a Cup or Pin flange, the large geared shoulder sweeps the nest upward, and wrist rotation establishes the desired upright or lying placement attitude.
distinguishing_idea: A broad sector-geared shoulder carries a shallow rim-supporting nest while a coaxial wrist controls orientation independently of the lift arc.
main_uncertainty: Sector backlash, wrist torque, and retention through the sweep are undetermined with the approximate object geometry; joints and controls are not implemented.

name: Toggle-Knee Pop-Up Tray
mechanism_family: Over-center knee linkage with low transfer tray and terminal tip
scoring_sequence: Counter-rotating front rollers load a low tray; a powered knee unfolds two serial link pairs to raise the tray nearly vertically, then a terminal tipping link meters the object onto the Goal.
distinguishing_idea: A compact folded knee straightens into a tall load-bearing column, gaining height through an over-center serial linkage rather than crossed scissor members or a mast.
main_uncertainty: Over-center force variation, side stiffness, and safe tray attitude need investigation; joints and controls are not implemented in this static preview.
